messages:
Anna C: Hey! New hire question — I got added to Okta but I can’t find the Grafana folders for my team (payments). Where do we keep service dashboards?
Mike R: Welcome Anna :wave: Most teams have a folder under Grafana > Team Dashboards. For payments it should be /dashboards/payments or the slug `payments-overview`. Try this link: https://grafana.redwood-infra.com/d/payments-overview (might redirect)
Anna C: That link 403s for me — says I need Viewer access. I tried the Observability group in Okta but it’s not listed under my apps.
DevEx Bot: Hi Anna — To request Grafana/Datadog/Sentry access, please fill the access form: https://redwood-internal/selfservice/observability-access. Include your team, CI owner, and the services you need. Typical group names: `obs-viewer`, `obs-edit`, `obs-admin`.
Anna C: Filled the form just now, put "Payments - backend" as team and payment-service as service. How long does it usually take?
Sophia L: Usually <24h on business days. If you need immediate view-only access for triage, ping `@mike-r` or add me and I can share a direct dashboard link.
Mike R: I can grant a short-lived Grafana Viewer token if you need it now. Run this from the infra jumpbox if you have SSH: 
```
# request temp viewer link
ssh jumpbox && /opt/infra/tools/temp-grafana-link --service payments --ttl 2h
```
Mike R: Otherwise I'll approve the Okta group add after the access ticket processes.
Anna C: I don’t have jumpbox SSH yet (still onboarding step). Can someone paste the specific dashboard URLs I should watch once access is live?
Sophia L: Sure — core ones for payments:
- https://grafana.redwood-infra.com/d/payments-overview (SLOs, latency by region)
- https://grafana.redwood-infra.com/d/payments-errors (error rates / traces link to Sentry)
- Datadog dashboards: https://app.datadoghq.com/dashboard/payments-overview (requires Datadog read)
- Sentry project: https://sentry.redwood-infra.com/organizations/redwood/issues/?project=payments
Anna C: Awesome, thanks. For Sentry — do I need a separate invite or is it via the same Okta group?
DevEx Bot: Sentry access is controlled via Okta SCIM groups. If you requested `sentry-read` or `obs-viewer` on the form, you will be added automatically. If it’s urgent, mention Sentry in the request notes.
Anna C: Got it. One last thing — who owns the payments dashboards? Want to make a tiny edit to add a link to a runbook.
Mike R: Owners are listed in the Grafana folder metadata — I’ll check and tag the owner. If you need to add a runbook link now, post it here and I’ll add it under the dashboard description.
Anna C: Thanks, I’ll drop the runbook URL once access is in. Appreciate the quick help! :raised_hands:
